spans.s:
√lap (lápati; lalā́pa; lapiṣyáti; lapitá,
laptá; láptum; -lápya). chatter; talk;
lament. [cf. ὀ-λοφ-ύ-ς, ‘a lamenting’;
ὀλοφύρομαι, ‘lament’; perhaps Lat. lāmenta,
‘laments.’]
+ ā, talk to, converse with.
+ pra, talk out heedlessly or lamentingly.
+ vi, utter unintelligible or lamenting
tones.
+ sam, talk with; caus. (cause to talk
with one, i. e.) address, 26^1.
